Like normal §1Brine§r, §6Salar Brine§r can be drilled from a fluid deposit with a §dFluid Drilling Rig§r.
And like Brine, Salar Brine is clarified with §3Calcium Hydroxide Slurry§r and then §3Soda Ash Solution§r. This gives you §6Decalcified Salar Brine§r.
Compress this with a §3Cellulose Acetate Membrane§r and react it Soda Ash Solution and then again with §3Hydrochloric Acid§r. This will give you §4Lithium Carbonate and Boric Acid§r.
